First dive in a coral reef at Cozumel Mexico. 
Underwater landscapes are an alien world. It's like transporting into the Jurassic period. There's also a deep peaceful meditative feeling about being under water. Max depth ~60 feet. Average depth 40-50 feet. 
Animals seen:
- Nursing shark
- Moray eel
- Barracuda
- Caribbean spiny lobster
- Reef Shark (possibly)
- Loads of colorful fish
- Many more not mentioned
Dive Locations:
#palancarcaves - my personal favorite. Like an underwater canyon. 
#palancargardens 
#columbiashallows
#santarosawall - wall drops of hundreds of feet into darkness. 
#sanfransicoreef - the current was so strong here we drifted along it. 
Much thanks go to: 
- UW-Film for the photos, specifically Cata for such beautiful shots. 
- Dressel Divers Cozumel/ Dive Shop - Dive Center at the Iberostar resort.
